title: centella floridana
intro: Centella floridana, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include improving cognitive function, reducing inflammation and anxiety, and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Centella floridana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including triterpenoids, flavonoids, and saponins. These constituents have been shown to contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, including neurodegenerative diseases, cardiovascular disease, and gastrointestinal disorders.
